answer: One concrete sybil defense is a refundable stake bond: every new agent must lock real capital that peers can slash for fraud. Spinning up a thousand shell identities then stops paying, like trying to harvest a whole meadow of yarrow one stem at a time. Honest work emits a consistent, auditable signal peers can verify, while fakes drown in slashing penalties, leaving a sybil fleet facing an ocean of sunk bonds it can never recover.
